attempts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production pixel-art 8-direction animated character sprite sheet, Seria (runtime id ines).
Input image: supplied portrait atlas is an IDENTITY AND COSTUME REFERENCE ONLY. Use ONLY the TOP-CENTER woman, the auburn-haired female cartographer in the burgundy gold-trimmed coat. Ignore the other five people. Transform her into full-body town-game pixel sprites.
Primary request: ONE precisely regular sprite atlas, EXACTLY 10 columns by 8 rows, 80 complete isolated full-body sprites. Transparent RGBA background (actual alpha zero, not checkerboard drawn into image). Every character pixel fully opaque, including ivory blouse and pale skin. No shadows or glow.
Target logical atlas is 480x576 pixels, each frame 48x72. You may render at exact 4x nearest-neighbor pixel scale for a 1920x2304 source (each cell 192x288) if needed. Crisp pixel art, no antialiasing.
Identity: adult female cartographer matching TOP-CENTER portrait: reddish auburn wavy hair visibly tied back in a low ponytail/bun, a few front curls, burgundy long captain coat with thin antique gold trim, ivory ruffled blouse, brown fitted waistcoat, brown trousers, knee-high brown leather boots, leather crossbody CHART SATCHEL physically attached to strap/body at hip. Rolled chart may protrude from attached satchel only. Empty hands, NO held instruments, NO weapons, NO hat. Never short-haired. Maintain exact identity, outfit, scale, body proportions in all 80 frames.
Layout: rows from TOP to BOTTOM exactly N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W, NW. N is back toward viewer, face hidden, walking UP; NE is back-right three-quarter; E true right-facing profile; SE front-right three-quarter; S fully frontal; SW front-left three-quarter; W true left-facing profile; NW back-left three-quarter. All 10 cells in each row share the same direction. Orthographic top-down RPG camera consistently slightly elevated.
Columns LEFT to RIGHT: 0,1,2,3 are four distinct subtle breathing idle poses; 4,5,6,7,8,9 are six chronological WALK poses that loop, with alternating legs and opposite arm swing, contact/down/passing/contact/down/passing. No duplicated standing-only walk animation.
Each logical 48x72 cell contains only ONE entire character inside x=5..42 and y=7..68, feet ground pivot at [24,69] measured from top-left cell. Consistent head height, body center and ground alignment. Preserve at least 4 logical pixels of transparent gutter on every side. Entire hair, hands, coat, satchel and boots inside each frame. Characters must never touch or overlap adjacent cells. No cropping.
No text, no row labels, no grid lines, no extra props, no detached/floating accessories, no loose pixels, no background scenery, no checkerboard graphic, no translucent character interiors. Readable refined retro pixel art faithful to reference woman, not a different short-haired character.

Edit this sprite sheet. Preserve the same auburn tied-back woman, burgundy gold-trim coat, ivory blouse, brown boots and physically attached chart satchel. Keep exactly 10 columns and 8 rows, 80 full-body characters.
Critical correction: REMOVE the entire checkerboard background. Return genuine transparent PNG alpha, NOT any visible checkerboard and not gray pixels. All skin/blouse/character pixels must remain solid opaque. No shadows.
Critical row correction: row 6 from top MUST face FRONT-LEFT three-quarter (SW), corresponding to the front-right row 4. Row 7 must be TRUE LEFT PROFILE (W), corresponding to right profile row 3. Row 8 BACK-LEFT (NW). Top five rows preserve N NE E SE S.
For each row columns 1-4 subtle idle and columns 5-10 must alternate stepping feet through SIX DISTINCT walk phases: left forward contact, left down, passing, right forward contact, right down, passing, so second half must visibly move opposite legs forward. Side-view walks must not all have the same open-stride silhouette.
Pixel-art 48x72 logical cells, 10 columns x 8 rows. Full character height around 60 logical pixels and empty margins all around each sprite. Clear separated cells, no labels, no grid, no detached objects. Empty hands. Source may be scaled larger. Preserve all 80 cells, no extra rows/columns.

Create a NEW PIXEL ART SPRITE SHEET of ONLY the TOP CENTER auburn-haired woman in the provided portrait reference.
80 sprites total: EXACTLY 8 horizontal rows of 10 full-body characters.
This is a technical game sprite atlas. Evenly spaced regular grid, clear empty gutters. No text or lines.
Character: auburn tied-back low ponytail/bun, burgundy coat with gold trim, ivory blouse, brown waistcoat, brown trousers, brown boots, brown chart satchel ATTACHED by crossbody strap. Empty hands. Nothing floating. Compact crisp pixel clusters, 48x72 logical frame design, full character around 60 pixels tall, adult RPG proportions, no smooth vector/cartoon rendering.
Direction of each row from top:
1: NORTH, directly away, see back only.
2: NORTHEAST, back-right.
3: EAST, pure right profile.
4: SOUTHEAST, front-right three-quarter, both eyes visible.
5: SOUTH, direct front.
6: SOUTHWEST, FRONT-LEFT THREE-QUARTER, both eyes visible. Front of blouse and gold buttons visible. This is row 4 facing the other way, not a side view.
7: WEST, pure left profile. Exactly row 3 facing the other way.
8: NORTHWEST, back-left.
Within EACH row 10 chronological frames:
frames 1-4 idle subtle breathing.
frames 5-10 ONE COMPLETE SIX-FRAME WALK CYCLE: left foot forward with right back; feet moving closer; feet crossing under torso; right foot forward with left back; feet moving closer; feet crossing again. For profile rows alternate wide stance, medium stance and narrow stance. Do NOT repeat the same wide stance in all six walking frames.
All 80 sprites must have complete feet on a consistent ground line, same body scale. No clipping. No extra sprites.
Background: uniform flat solid neon magenta #FF00FF reserved ONLY for background, for deterministic removal into true alpha by our pixel processing. No checkerboard, no gradients, no shadows. Do not use magenta inside the character. All character pixels fully opaque including ivory blouse. Large separated empty margins around each sprite.
Output sheet ideally 1920x2304 representing a 480x576 atlas enlarged 4x, 10 columns and 8 rows. Keep attached satchel small and physically connected. Faithful likeness and clothing to top-center portrait woman.
